english.title: Use aircraft for the purpose of dropping persons without certificate of airworthiness / authorisation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command of]_

an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) which was used for the purpose of dropping persons when

(C)_[it did not have a certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for that aircraft under the law of **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY..), the country in which the aircraft was registered.]_
(D)_[the certificate of airworthiness for the aircraft, did not include an express provision that it may be used for that purpose.]_
(E)_[the flight manual for the aircraft, did not include an express provision that it may be used for that purpose.]_
(F)_[it had not been authorised for the purpose of dropping persons by the CAA or an organisation approved by the CAA to provide such an authorisation.]_
(G)_[it was not operated in accordance with a written permission granted by the CAA under article 90 of the Air Navigation Order 2016.]_
(H)_[it was not operated under and in accordance with the terms of a police air operator's certificate.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 90(4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
